title: Eleven Feet by 1961
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：bamboo　|　正文 316 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bamboo 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my grandfather planted ① a bamboo against a north wall and was told it would never take. The ② bamboo, meaning the one plant and not the hedge it became, was nine feet by 1959 and eleven by 1961; a bamboo, he said, is the only thing you plant that argues with you about where it wants to be.

Every ③ bamboo in that garden came from the same root, and the ④ bamboo by the fence, meaning the one he cut and not either of those, grew back twice as fast the following March. A bamboo, my grandmother said, is nine parts root and one part patience in other people; my grandfather said the root does all the arguing.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ bamboo was the whole of the shed, meaning the poles and not the plant. The ⑥ bamboo, meaning the material and not any of that, held up eleven rows of beans and a door that had no hinge; a bamboo, she said, is either something you grow or the only crop that arrives as a building. He said the building was never planned.

By 1968 the ⑦ bamboo had become a complaint from the neighbour, and the complaint had become an argument about roots and property. The ⑧ bamboo of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in April, was nine years of shade and one letter; a bamboo, he said, is either the hedge you wanted or the hedge you have to explain. She said the explaining is the expensive half.

The ⑨ bamboo I remember is the one against the north wall, which was cut down in 1973 and came back in 1974. A ⑩ bamboo, my mother said in 1976, is the only plant that improves by being cut; every bamboo, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a fence. She said the fence was never the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 竹子（指植物、竹丛）
B. n. 竹子（指种下的那一株，与后来长成的树篱相对）
C. 固定搭配：plant a bamboo 种一株竹子
D. n. 竹子（指园里每一株）
E. n. 竹子（指篱边那一株）
F. n. 竹子（指竹材、竹竿）
G. n. 竹子（抽象：作为材料这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bamboo against a north wall
The bamboo, meaning the one plant and not the hedge it became
bamboo was the whole of the shed
the bamboo had become a complaint from the neighbour
The bamboo of the whole thing
A bamboo, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: plant a bamboo 意为“种一株竹子”，1952 年祖父在北墙边种了一株竹子，别人说它活不成。
bamboo 意为“竹子”，指种下的那一株而不是后来长成的树篱，到 1959 年九英尺，1961 年十一英尺。
bamboo 指园里每一株竹子，那个园子里每一株都来自同一条根。
bamboo 指篱边那一株（他砍掉的那株），第二年三月长得快了一倍。
bamboo 意为“竹材、竹竿”，母亲说竹子就是那间棚屋的全部，指的是竹竿而不是那株植物。
bamboo 为抽象用法，指作为材料这件事，它撑起了十一行豆子和一扇没有铰链的门。
bamboo 意为“竹子”，到 1968 年这个 bamboo 成了邻居的一句抱怨。
bamboo 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖父四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的阴凉和一封信。
bamboo 意为“竹子”，我记得的是北墙边那一株，1973 年被砍掉，1974 年又长回来。
bamboo 为抽象总称，母亲说竹子是唯一会因为被砍而长得更好的植物。
